name: find_files
description: Finds files by name anywhere under a directory: pass pattern and optionally dir. A pattern with no wildcard matches any name containing it, and * and ? work as globs (e.g. "*.tool.json"). Use this when you have a name from a stack trace, an import or a half-remembered path; use list_files when you know the directory, and search_code when you know the contents rather than the name.

pattern.description: Part of a file name, e.g. "loop", or a glob such as "*.tool.json".

dir.description: Directory to search under, relative to the sandbox root. Defaults to ".".
